prototype_feel_reasons: The truck and school icons feel slightly detached from each other and the tray because they float without a shared route, panel, or stronger alignment.
The four status marks lack labels or a surrounding component, making them resemble temporary debug indicators.
The orange card marker is positioned differently from the centered status marks and has little visual context.
Disabled candidate artwork is very faint, slightly weakening consistency and legibility.
issues: 08-deliver-ready/top delivery icons — truck and school use noticeably different visual footprints and float in open space — place them in a consistently aligned delivery-status row or connect them with a subtle route indicator.
08-deliver-ready/status marks — four unlabelled circles read as provisional indicators — add a compact status container, semantic icons, or clearer selected/completed states.

08-deliver-ready/fried-chicken candidate marker — orange dot floats close to the card corner without explaining its relationship to the item — anchor it to a consistent badge position with padding and, if appropriate, a small label.

08-deliver-ready/disabled candidate cards — low-opacity food images become unnecessarily washed out against already pale cards — retain more image contrast and communicate disabled state through a controlled overlay or border treatment.
